description: Tests whether a Jev rerank beats embedding search over the Agent Skills Hub catalog. It uses 164 Chinese and English queries and measures judge bias.
how_used_jev: Jev scores the top 30 results of each base ranker. The author reports that fusing bge-m3 with the Jev rerank gives +0.090 NDCG@10 over bge-m3 alone.
